entities.createSql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` USING FTS4(`text` TEXT NOT NULL, tokenize=unicode61, content=`transcript_lines`)
contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_transcript_search_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `transcript_lines` BEGIN DELETE FROM `transcript_search` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_transcript_search_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `transcript_lines` BEGIN DELETE FROM `transcript_search` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_transcript_search_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON `transcript_lines` BEGIN INSERT INTO `transcript_search`(`docid`, `text`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`text`); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_transcript_search_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `transcript_lines` BEGIN INSERT INTO `transcript_search`(`docid`, `text`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`text`); END
